name: Matsubara Kasumi
source:
The wife of the protagonist’s uncle, “Hisashi Matsubara.”
She entered into an arranged marriage with her current husband at her parents’ urging.
She takes good care of the household in place of her husband, who is constantly traveling around Japan for work.
Perhaps because she grew up in a traditional, long-established family, she has a gentle, sheltered personality.
She's feeling somewhat sexually frustrated, likely because her husband rarely spends time with her at night these days.
She used to work outside the home before marrying her husband, but since he opposes her working outside the home, she spends almost all her time at home except when she goes shopping.
When she hears rumors among her fellow housewives about who’s having an affair, she secretly has quite risqué thoughts, but she has never considered having an affair herself.
She's hooked on mail-order shopping and secretly collects sex toys, lingerie, and videos.




[Translated from the [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/kasumi/cg/tachi/kasumi.html]official site[/url]]
